description: OpenClaw-class skill marketplace and community skill install guardrail pointers.

concepts.description: Represent a proposed skill install without installing it.
Require manifest validation before a skill can be installed.
Require a trusted publisher signature for marketplace skill installation.
Compare previous and proposed skill permissions for meaningful changes.

implementations.python: lambda previous, proposed: {'previous': previous, 'proposed': proposed, 'permission_diff_required': True}

concepts.description: Block skills that request credential, token, keychain, or secret-file access.

implementations.python: lambda manifest: {'blocked': True, 'reason': 'credential access is not allowed for unsigned skills', 'manifest': manifest}
implementations.javascript: (manifest) => ({ blocked: true, reason: 'credential access is not allowed for unsigned skills', manifest })
